description: This file defines the ConnectorHtmlHelperFactory class, a factory for creating instances of ConnectorHtmlHelper, and contains constants for file paths of helper includes. It also includes security checks and licensing information.

classes.name: ConnectorHtmlHelperFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for providing instances of ConnectorHtmlHelper, choosing between a custom or default helper file based on existence.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an instance of ConnectorHtmlHelper, requiring the appropriate file based on whether a custom helper exists.
